item.title: Clean Sweep 0.6.1 Preview
item.description:
# Clean Sweep 0.6.1 Preview
- **Clone** is the default marking brush for new or unset preferences. Your saved Remove, Heal, or Clone choice is preserved. - Fix Settings errors after updating an already-open Lightroom installation. Brush preferences now use an existing module, and the Settings menu uses an established menu script, avoiding the new-script dependencies that triggered `MarkingTool` and `Settings.lua` errors. - **Clear Queue** returns from a Clean Sweep review collection to your previous photo and browsing view before emptying the collection. If you already browsed elsewhere, it preserves that newer location. After a plug-in reload, the current photo’s catalog folder is used when the earlier view is no longer known.
Finish or stop your batch, close the floating window, replace the complete plug-in folder, then fully quit and reopen Lightroom once to refresh its cached scripts and menu entries. Your photo edits, saved preferences, and update connection are kept. Clearing the queue still asks for confirmation and preserves photo edits and recovery snapshots.
Automated tests cover the default and saved brush choices, both Settings menu routes, clearing from either review collection, later manual navigation, reload fallback, filtered-photo recovery, and canceled or failed clearing. Native interaction with this patch still needs manual verification in Lightroom.
